observations.why: Imperative directive commanding erasure of knowledge enacts authority-ranking — a speaker issuing a binding order to an audience.
Second imperative command to purge information continues the authority-ranking enactment — directive control over what the audience may know.

mints.name: MandateKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: direct another party to forget or remove knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker claiming authority to command what the audience must purge from memory or records?
